notes: NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 125 teams for 2014. ESPN preseason FPI ranked 128 FBS teams. The 3-team gap matches the three year-2 reclassifying programs that played full FBS conference schedules (Appalachian State, Georgia Southern, Old Dominion); that mapping is my inference, the NCAA table does not name them. Count here INCLUDES year-2 transitional programs.

NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 127 for 2015. 128 = 127 full members + Charlotte (transition year 2, in Conference USA). UAB did not field a team in 2015 (program shut down after 2014) and is not counted. 128 figure taken from news rankings of 'all 128 teams' (Bleacher Report; USA Today also ranked 128); no NCAA page stating 128 was retrieved.

NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 128 for 2016. No year-2 transitional program played an FBS schedule in 2016 (Coastal Carolina was in transition year 1 as an FCS independent and is NOT counted). UAB still dormant.

NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 129 for 2017. 130 = 129 full members + Coastal Carolina (transition year 2, Sun Belt). UAB returned in 2017. CBS Sports ranked 'all 130 FBS teams'.

NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 129 for 2018. 130 = 129 full members + Liberty (transition year 2, FBS independent). Idaho dropped to FCS effective 1 Jul 2018. NBC Sports: FBS 'will once again enter 2018 with 130 FBS member schools'.
NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 130 for 2019. No transitional programs in 2019 (Liberty became a full member).

130 FBS members; 3 did not play in fall 2020 (UConn, Old Dominion, New Mexico State), so 127 played. Source quotes Brett McMurphy: 'three of the 130 FBS teams still not playing in 2020'. New Mexico State planned a short spring-2021 slate (not verified here whether NCAA counts those games in the 2020 season). NCAA attendance table has no 2020 row ('No attendance tracked due to COVID limitations'). No transitional programs.

CBS Sports ranked all 130 FBS teams for 2021. DISCREPANCY: NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 129 for 2021; I could not find the reason for the NCAA figure being one short (no transitional program was playing an FBS schedule in 2021). Treat 130 as the membership count; NCAA-table 129 unexplained.

CBS Sports 131: 'every team at the FBS level, now including James Madison'. NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 130 for 2022, i.e. it excludes James Madison (transition year 1, but played a full Sun Belt/FBS schedule). 131 INCLUDES JMU. Jacksonville State and Sam Houston were in transition year 1 but played FCS schedules (ASUN/WAC) and are NOT counted.

NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 133 for 2023 (unlike 2014-2018 and 2022, the NCAA table here includes the transitional programs). 133 = 130 full members + James Madison, Jacksonville State, Sam Houston (all transition year 2). Kennesaw State (year 1, FCS schedule) NOT counted.

NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 134 for 2024. Includes Kennesaw State (transition year 2, Conference USA). Delaware and Missouri State (year 1, FCS schedules in CAA/MVFC) NOT counted.

NCAA attendance records table 'Annual FBS attendance' (Attend.pdf) lists 136 for 2025. Includes Delaware and Missouri State (transition year 2, Conference USA). CBS: 'the FBS ballooned to 136 teams, the most in history'.

VERIFIED 138, not 136. Added for 2026: North Dakota State (MVFC -> Mountain West, football-only) and Sacramento State (Big Sky -> MAC, football-only). Both are in reclassification year 1 but, unlike past year-1 programs, play full FBS conference schedules in 2026 and are counted in every 2026 FBS list found (ESPN 'all 138 FBS teams', CBS Sports 138).
